Definition: a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance
BiblicalUsage: The word is a stay, a support, and David uses it for God in the day of calamity: they prevented me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my stay. Isaiah turns it around: God takes away from Jerusalem the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread and the whole stay of water.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stay is the test of trust. When God is my stay, nothing can shake me, and when He takes the stay away, nothing else can hold the city up.
